blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte should answer allegations of corruption with evidence instead of pointing fingers at the administration, Malacañang said on Sunday. Palace press officer Undersecretary Claire Castro said claims raised by whistleblower, dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., should be investigated, but the government should first establish the truth before making any judgment.
